ALTER TABLE buyerRequests 
DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS spamScore,
DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS spamFactors,
DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS flaggedAt;

-- Add publishedAt field
ALTER TABLE buyerRequests 
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS publishedAt TIMESTAMP NULL AFTER updatedAt;

-- Update status enum to include pending, published, unpublished
-- Note: MySQL doesn't allow direct ENUM modification, so we'll handle this through application logic
-- The schema change will be reflected in drizzle-kit migrations
